text:
Which statements explain why zinc is used to protect iron from rusting?
1
Zinc is more reactive than iron.
2
Zinc is less reactive than iron.
3
Zinc can form alloys with iron.
4
Zinc acts as a sacrificial metal.
A
1 and 3
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
2 and 4
subject: Chemistry
